description: Delete a voice agent. Requires the OWNER or ADMIN role. The agent is marked deleted and no tool can restore it: it stops appearing in list_voice_agents, and its share link, embedded widget, questions, and test suite stop working. Its stored data is not erased, past conversations stay in list_voice_conversations, and phone numbers assigned to it are not released.

agentId.description: ID of the voice agent to delete (from list_voice_agents)

name: delete_voice_agent

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API
